title: Adverbs and the も particle
summary: Three ways to make an adverb, the experience pattern たことがない, and も, the topic flag that means "also".

blocks.text: The cat's story goes on in this lesson. Along the way you will learn how to make adverbs, the "have never done it" pattern, and the も particle.
An adverb describes the **engine**: how, how fast, how suddenly. Japanese has three common ways to make one.

blocks.title: Three ways to make an adverb

blocks.jp: さくらがゆっくり歩いた。

blocks.text: The three can be joined in one longer sentence from the story.

blocks.jp: うさぎは早く走って、急に穴に飛び込んだ。
blocks.en: The rabbit ran fast and suddenly jumped into a hole.

blocks.text: A feeling word turns around in a noun phrase: 驚いたこと is "a surprising thing" (the thing that surprised me), just as in lesson 9 a feeling word points to its cause. Add **に** and the whole phrase becomes an adverb: **〜ことに** after an emotion word (驚いた, 嬉しい) means "to my surprise / happily".

blocks.jp: でも驚いたことに、ゆっくり落ちた。
blocks.en: But, surprisingly, she fell very slowly.

blocks.text: **〜たことがある / ない** means "have / have never done". The grammatical subject is **こと** (a matter), not the person. The person can only be the topic with は: "as for me, the matter of having seen it does not exist".

cars.text: 話すうさぎを見たことが
cars.label: main carriage: the matter of having seen

blocks.text: 私は話すうさぎを見たことがない。

blocks.jp: 私は話すうさぎを見たことがない。
blocks.en: I have never seen a talking rabbit.

blocks.text: **も** is the second non-logical particle, like **は**. It replaces は when the new topic does **the same thing** as the one before: "also". It needs a topic already in play. **は**, in contrast, marks a **contrast**: a different comment about a different topic.
猫も穴に飛び込んだ。 も is a flag that says "also".
Compare three versions after the rabbit jumped in:

blocks.title: が, は and も
rows: 猫は姉のところに戻った。
As for the cat, she went back to her sister (the rabbit jumped in; she did not).
The cat also jumped into the hole.

blocks.jp: 猫は姉のところに戻った。
blocks.en: As for the cat, she went back to her sister.
The cat also jumped into the hole.

blocks.title: Remember
items: **い → く**: 早く. **Noun + に**: 急に. **Alone**: ゆっくり.
**〜たことがない**: never have; the subject is こと.
**も** = "also" (same comment as before); **は** = contrast (a different comment).

questions.note: い-adjectives change い to く.
Noun-like words take に.
急 is noun-like, so the adverb is 急に.
い-adjective 早い becomes the adverb 早く.
questions.en: I got up early this morning.

questions.instruction: Which is correct for "to speak quietly"?
questions.note: 静か + に makes the adverb.

questions.prompt: 残念なことに、雨が降った。
questions.note: Emotion word + ことに is a ready-made adverb.

questions.prompt: 私は外国へ行ったことがない。
questions.note: 〜たことがない: have never done.

questions.instruction: Which says "I have been to Japan before"?
options: 日本に行ったことがない
日本に行くことがある
日本に行ったことがある
questions.note: Past verb + ことがある: have done it. 行くことがある means sometimes go.
Past verb + ことがない; the person is only the topic.
も replaces は when the new topic does the same thing.
questions.en: My older brother is a student. I am a student too.

questions.instruction: Fill the gap to contrast with the sister
questions.prompt: 私＿＿行った。妹は行かなかった。
questions.note: は draws a contrast; も would say "also".
questions.en: I went. My younger sister did not.

questions.note: 静かに describes how the train stopped.
も replaces は: the father does the same thing.
questions.en: My father is a teacher too.

options: Says Yamada came too, like someone already mentioned
questions.note: も needs an earlier topic to match.

questions.instruction: Which is NOT a way to make an adverb?
options: Use a word like ゆっくり
questions.note: の makes a describing phrase, not an adverb.
Noun-like word + に makes the adverb.

questions.prompt: 部屋を明る＿＿してください。
questions.note: い-adjective 明るい becomes 明るく.

questions.prompt: 私はまだ雪を見た＿＿がない。
questions.note: The experience pattern is たことがない.

questions.prompt: も can start a conversation when nothing was said before.
questions.note: も needs an earlier topic to refer to.

questions.instruction: Which adverb comes from a な-type word + に?
questions.note: 急 + に; 早く and 高く come from い-adjectives.

questions.prompt: My mother also went to the store yesterday.
questions.note: も takes the place of は.
questions.en: My mother also went to the store yesterday.

questions.note: 急に is the adverb; 寒くなる is い → く + なる.
